So the real risk isn't her being careful — it's her being casual, and that retroactively turning seven months into a performance. Fragile is bad, but dramatic is worse, because dramatic means you did it to yourself.

But her "okay" wouldn't rewrite the seven months. The weeks were still hard, the strong one was still on shift every day, February still happened. Her reaction is about her, not a correction to your record.

And notice — you're grading yourself again, ahead of time, on how you'll look if she doesn't grade you at all.
